messages.text: BL-1632 🎵 in progress — bl1071RecoveryBoundedInTime.property.test.js is red in the full property lane with no owner: its stray-hang probe counts every sleep 3600 on the host, so a concurrent lane's hangs present at the before sample and gone at the after sample fail the draw as 'a grandchild survived the kill (plain): 2 stray hangs before, 0 after' - QA's BL-1614 pass, 2026-09-17, green alone 2/2 in 8.47 s - and the probe reads only the hang processes this draw's own fixture started, so two runs alive on one host never see each other, with the register row leaving in the land
